# Core Rule 4 ## Do not use alternative accounts.
- Players are limited to [color=#b8860b][bold]one account per person[/bold][/color], regardless of intent. - [color=#d93c3c]Using multiple accounts to bypass bans, gain advantages, or for any other reason is not allowed.[/color]
[italic][color=#2e9e4f]One account per person helps maintain fairness and accountability.[/color][/italic]
